tools.name: get_overview
tools.description: Returns the Pontis site guide (llms.txt) as markdown: who Pontis is, its gatherings and content hubs, the groups it connects, its seven focus areas and contact details, every page on the site, and the facts that must not be inferred.

tools.name: read_page
tools.description: Returns one page of pontis.company as markdown, without navigation or footer. Pass its path, for example "/", "/about", "/knowledge" or "/events/human-ai-europe".
